name: dictate
description: Dictate: a clickable mic for Claude Code's built-in voice dictation. Click to start, click again to send, × to discard.

icon.title: Mic icon
icon.description: nerd: Nerd Font microphone (needs a Nerd Font in the terminal). emoji: the 🎤 emoji.

beside.title: Share the row with another band plugin
beside.description: On when another plugin (e.g. AFKSwitch) draws a 3-row card in the band above Dictate's: the two sit side by side instead of stacking. Leave off otherwise.
